jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

The objective of the role is to optimize DTC performance, identify and drive key levers, increase conversion rate to drive channel revenue, effectiveness and efficiency.
Optimize Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) performance by identifying and activating key growth levers that improve revenue generation across markets and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) sub-channels, conversion, channel effectiveness and operational and investment efficiency.

- Performance analysis: monitor and analyse performance against channel and commercial KPIs, providing channel-specific insights and recommendations by market to maximize revenue per B2C sub-channel (Web, Call Centre and Future Sales) and drive continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key KPIs.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by sub-channel by market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact channels.

- Develop attribution models to identify channel levers which drive revenue.

- Build and maintain B2C performance scorecards by market to monitor and optimize B2C channel performance, identifying drop-off points. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Partner with Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Centre and Future Sales to improve customer journeys, reduce friction, increase conversion, repeat and customer lifetime value.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, DTC analytics or eCommerce performance.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of direct sales channels

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Il meglio delle vostre avventure è quello che dovete ancora navigare!

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un talentuoso, esperto di analisi, un professionista strategico e altamente organizzato con un forte acume commerciale per unire il nostro nuovo marchio di viaggio di lusso Explora Journeys, con sede nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, in Svizzera.

Il tuo impatto

L'obiettivo del ruolo è quello di ottimizzare le prestazioni DTC, identificare e guidare le leve chiave, aumentare il tasso di conversione per guidare le entrate del canale, l'efficacia e l'efficienza.
Ottimizzare le prestazioni Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) identificando e attivando leve di crescita chiave che migliorano la generazione dei ricavi su mercati e sub-canale Business-to-Consumer (B2C), conversione, efficacia dei canali e efficienza operativa e di investimento.

- Analisi delle prestazioni: monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni contro i canali e i KPI commerciali, fornendo intuizioni e raccomandazioni specifiche del canale per il mercato per massimizzare i ricavi per il sub-canale B2C (Web, Call Centre e Future Sales) e guidare il miglioramento continuo. Possedere lo sviluppo, il monitoraggio e l'azione dei KPI chiave.

- Efficienza di trasmissione, quantificazione ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA da sottocanale da mercato per ottimizzare continuamente gli investimenti. Raccomanda reinvestimenti verso i canali più elevati di impatto.

- Sviluppare modelli di attribuzione per identificare leve del canale che guidano le entrate.

- Costruire e mantenere le schede di rendimento B2C per mercato per monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni del canale B2C, identificare i punti di drop-off. Sia in Excel che in collaborazione con il team aziendale per renderlo disponibile negli strumenti self-serve (Power BI).

- Partner con Media, Digital, Commerciale, Vendite, IT, Call Centre e Future Sales per migliorare i viaggi dei clienti, ridurre l'attrito, aumentare la conversione, ripetere e il valore della vita del cliente.

- Analisi competitiva: monitorare le condizioni di mercato, l'attività competitiva e le tendenze del settore per sostenere la pianificazione strategica e identificare le opportunità di differenziazione e crescita.

- Preparare presentazioni esecutive, con chiare raccomandazioni basate sui dati per supportare il processo decisionale strategico di leadership senior, sfruttando la visualizzazione dei dati stellari combinata con la profondità di insight.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 5+ anni di esperienza precedente in analisi commerciali, intelligenza aziendale, analisi DTC o prestazioni di eCommerce.

- Preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso / viaggio o agenzie di consulenza.

- Corso di laurea in Business, Economia, Finanza, Marketing, Commerciale o relativo campo (Master, MBA o equivalente esperienza preferita).

I tuoi essenziali

- Esperienza comprovata che supporta i dirigenti senior e prospera in un ambiente di avvio veloce, gestendo contemporaneamente più priorità.

- Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight aziendali attuabili.

- Eccellente in Excel e confortevole manipolazione di dati di grandi dimensioni e mantenimento di grandi fogli di calcolo con alto livello di precisione

- eccezionali competenze di PowerPoint e storytelling — in grado di creare presentazioni pulite, croccanti, ad alto impatto per il pubblico C-suite.

- Esperienza di lavoro con Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics o piattaforme simili, nonché strumenti BI e di visualizzazione come Tableau, Power BI, Looker o piattaforme simili.

- Conoscenza dei canali di vendita diretti

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. Fluente in inglese.

- Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria del viaggio in continua evoluzione.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Wo Leidenschaft die Gelegenheit trifft

Das Beste eurer Abenteuer ist das, was ihr noch segelt!

Ihr Ziel

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die sich im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorstellt. Unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (vier derzeit in der Pipeline) wird auf eine ganz andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entwickelt, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis transformieren und neu definieren wird und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die an die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden appelliert.

Eine spannende Gelegenheit besteht für eine talentierte, kompetente Analyse, strategisch und hoch organisierte Profi mit starkem kommerziellen Umfeld, um unsere neu geschaffene Luxus-Reisemarke Explora Journeys mit Sitz in unseren Büros in Genf, Schweiz, beizutreten.

Ihre Auswirkungen

Ziel der Rolle ist es, die DTC-Leistung zu optimieren, Schlüsselhebel zu identifizieren und anzutreiben, die Conversion-Rate zu erhöhen, um Kanaleinnahmen, Effizienz und Effizienz zu treiben.
Optimieren Sie die Performance von Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) durch die Identifikation und Aktivierung von Schlüssel-Wachstumshebeln, die die Umsatzentwicklung über die Märkte hinweg verbessern und Unterkanäle von Business-to-Consumer (B2C), Umwandlung, Kanaleffizienz und Betriebs- und Investitionseffizienz.

- Leistungsanalyse: Überwachung und Analyse der Leistung gegen Kanal- und kommerzielle KPIs, Bereitstellung von kanalspezifischen Erkenntnissen und Empfehlungen auf dem Markt, um den Umsatz pro B2C-Subkanal (Web, Call Center und Future Sales) zu maximieren und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen zu erzielen. Eigene Entwicklung, Verfolgung und Aktion von Schlüsselkennzahlen.

- Antriebseffizienz, Quantifizierung von ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA durch Sub-Channel per Markt, um Investitionen kontinuierlich zu optimieren. Empfehlen Sie Reinvestments in Richtung höchster Kanäle.

- Entwickeln Sie Attribution-Modelle, um Kanalhebel zu identifizieren, die Einnahmen treiben.

- Bauen und pflegen B2C Performance Scorecards auf dem Markt, um die B2C Kanalleistung zu überwachen und zu optimieren, Drop-off-Punkte zu identifizieren. Sowohl bei Excel als auch bei der Zusammenarbeit mit dem Unternehmensteam, um es in Self-serve-Tools (Power BI) zur Verfügung zu stellen.

- Partner bei Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Center und Future Sales, um Kundenreisen zu verbessern, Reibung zu reduzieren, Umsatz zu erhöhen, Wiederholung und Kundenlebenswert.

- Wettbewerbsanalyse: Überwachung der Marktbedingungen, der Wettbewerbstätigkeit und der Branchentrends, um die strategische Planung zu unterstützen und Chancen für Differenzierung und Wachstum zu identifizieren.

- Bereiten Sie Executive-Ready-Präsentationen vor, mit klaren datenbasierten Empfehlungen, um leitende Führung strategische Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen, indem Sie die stellare Datenvisualisierung in Verbindung mit der Tiefe der Erkenntnisse nutzen.

Ihre Reise so weit

- 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der kommerziellen Analyse, Business Intelligence, DTC-Analysen oder E-Commerce-Performance.

- Vorliebe für Erfahrungen in der Luxus-Gast- und Reisebranche oder Beratungsagenturen.

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Marketing, Handel oder verwandten Bereich (Masters, MBA oder gleichwertige Erfahrung bevorzugt).

Ihre Essenzen

- Bewährte Erfahrungen bei der Unterstützung von leitenden Führungskräften und in einer schnelllebigen Start-up-Umgebung, die gleichzeitig mehrere Prioritäten verwaltet.

- Ausgezeichnete analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten in handlungsfähige Unternehmenseinsichten zu übersetzen.

- Hoch Proficient in Excel und komfortable Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen und Pflege großer Tabellenkalkulationen mit hoher Genauigkeit

- Herausragende PowerPoint- und Storytelling-Fähigkeiten – in der Lage, saubere, knackige, hocheffektive Präsentationen für C-suite Publikum zu erstellen.

- Erleben Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics oder ähnlichen Plattformen sowie BI- und Visualisierungstools wie Tableau, Power BI, Looker oder ähnliche Plattformen.

- Kenntnisse der Direktverkaufskanäle

- Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Fluent auf Englisch.

- Leidenschaft und Neugier, ständig über die sich ständig weiterentwickelnde Reisebranche zu erfahren.

Unser Engagement

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Le meilleur de vos aventures est celui que vous n'avez pas encore navigué !

Votre but

Explora Journeys est une marque de luxe européenne dynamique et cosmopolite, imaginée au cœur de l'hospitalité suisse à Genève. Tirant parti de notre société mère MSC Group de centaines d'années d'expertise maritime, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (quatre actuellement dans le pipeline) sont en cours de construction et de conception d'une manière totalement différente et unique qui transformera et redéfinira l'expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie propre, attrayant pour la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe.

Une opportunité passionnante existe pour un professionnel talentueux, compétent en analyse, stratégique et hautement organisé avec une forte acuité commerciale pour rejoindre notre nouvelle marque de voyage de luxe Explora Journeys, basée dans nos bureaux à Genève, Suisse.

Votre impact

L'objectif du rôle est d'optimiser la performance du CIPH, d'identifier et de piloter les leviers clés, d'augmenter le taux de conversion pour stimuler les revenus, l'efficacité et l'efficience des canaux.
Optimiser la performance des entreprises à consommateurs en identifiant et en activant les principaux leviers de croissance qui améliorent la production de revenus sur les marchés et les sous-canaux d'affaires à consommateurs (B2C), la conversion, l'efficacité des canaux et l'efficience opérationnelle et d'investissement.

- Analyse des performances : surveiller et analyser les performances par rapport aux KPI de canaux et commerciaux, en fournissant des informations et des recommandations spécifiques de canaux par marché afin de maximiser les revenus par sous-canal de B2C (Web, Call Centre et Future Sales) et de stimuler l'amélioration continue. Posséder le développement, le suivi et l'action des principaux ICR.

- Conduire l'efficacité, quantifier ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA par sous-canal par marché pour optimiser continuellement les investissements. Recommander des réinvestissements vers des canaux à plus fort impact.

- Élaborer des modèles d'attribution pour identifier les leviers de canaux qui génèrent des recettes.

- Construisez et maintenez des fiches de performance B2C par marché pour surveiller et optimiser les performances des canaux B2C, en identifiant les points de chute. À la fois sur Excel et en partenariat avec l'équipe d'entreprise pour le rendre disponible dans des outils en libre-service (Power BI).

- Partenaire avec Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenu, IT, Call Centre et Future Sales afin d'améliorer les déplacements des clients, de réduire les frictions, d'augmenter la conversion, de répéter et la valeur de vie du client.

- Analyse concurrentielle : surveiller les conditions du marché, les activités concurrentielles et les tendances de l'industrie pour appuyer la planification stratégique et identifier les possibilités de différenciation et de croissance.

- Préparer des présentations prêtes pour les cadres supérieurs, avec des recommandations claires fondées sur des données pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques des cadres supérieurs, en tirant parti de la visualisation des données stellaires combinée à la profondeur des idées.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- 5 ans d'expérience en analyse commerciale, intelligence d'affaires, analyse DTC ou performance eCommerce.

- préférence pour l'expérience antérieure dans l'hôtellerie de luxe/l'industrie du voyage ou les agences de conseil.

- Baccalauréat en affaires, économie, finances, marketing, commercial ou domaine connexe (maîtrise, MBA ou expérience équivalente préférée).

Vos essentiels

- Expérience éprouvée pour soutenir les cadres supérieurs et prospérer dans un environnement de démarrage rapide, en gérant simultanément plusieurs priorités.

- Excellentes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de traduire des données complexes en informations opérationnelles exploitables.

- Hautement compétent en Excel et confortable manipulant les données des grands ensembles de données et conservant de grands tableurs avec un haut niveau de précision

- Excellentes compétences en PowerPoint et en narration – capables d'élaborer des présentations propres, nettes et à impact élevé pour les auditoires C-suite.

- Expérience de travail avec Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics ou des plateformes similaires, ainsi que des outils BI et de visualisation tels que Tableau, Power BI, Looker ou des plateformes similaires.

- Connaissance des canaux de vente directe

- Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale. En anglais.

- Passion et curiosité d'apprendre continuellement l'industrie du voyage en constante évolution.

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

Preferred Skills

-
Basic understanding of guest satisfaction metrics and NPS

-
Basic understanding of employee engagement metrics

- Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools

- Interest in customer journey, guest experience, and service improvement

- Familiarity with survey data analysis and open‑comment analysis

What This Role Offers You:

- Hands-on experience in analytics, KPI development, and dashboarding

- Exposure to real business impact through data-driven decision-making

- Opportunity to work in a global, dynamic environment

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Unisciti a MSC Crociere per un entusiasmante stage focalizzato su analisi, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e generazione di informazioni in due aree strategiche: Customer Journey e il nostro miglior programma.

Questo ruolo è ideale per qualcuno appassionato di analisi dei dati, generazione di insight e creazione di dashboard, con un forte interesse a migliorare l'esperienza dei dipendenti e degli ospiti attraverso un impatto misurabile.

Sosterrai lo sviluppo di analisi strutturate e meccanismi di follow-up, lavorando a stretto contatto con il reparto Customer Journey e HR. Il ruolo fornisce un'esposizione pratica sia agli analytics orientati agli ospiti che ai dipendenti.

Il tuo impatto

Viaggio dei clienti:

- Sostenere le analisi del Customer Journey ricorrenti, incluse le recensioni basate su tela, le analisi della nave di mezza stagione e i responsabili dei comitati.

- Contribuire a analisi approfondite ad hoc su argomenti specifici, segmenti ospiti, nazionalità o navi, in base alle richieste di business e gestione.

- Preparare estrazioni di dati, grafici, tabelle e uscite analitiche di primo livello utilizzando modelli standardizzati.

- Mantenere i tracker di analisi del Customer Journey, assicurando la documentazione corretta, il controllo della versione e il monitoraggio dei piani di azione.

- Supporta analisi e aggiornamenti di follow-up dopo i piloti, modifiche operative o feedback di gestione.

- Assicurare l'accuratezza dei dati, la consistenza e l'allineamento attraverso il Customer Journey consegnabili e reporting.

Il nostro programma BEST:

- Sostenere lo sviluppo, la manutenzione e il monitoraggio dei framework KPI per il nostro programma BEST.

- Consolidare e analizzare i dati provenienti da più fonti, inclusi i sondaggi di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti, il feedback dei nostri clienti, la formazione di NPS e i relativi indicatori degli ospiti.

- Costruire, aggiornare e mantenere le dashboard per monitorare le prestazioni del programma, l'impegno e l'impatto nel tempo.

- Produrre rapporti regolari di performance e riassunti esecutivi strutturati per le recensioni di leadership.

- Assicurare la coerenza dei dati, la precisione e gli standard di report in tutti i nostri output di analisi BEST.

- Sostenere la preparazione di visualizzazioni di dati e materiali di storytelling per gli stakeholder senior.

- Avanzate competenze di Excel; la conoscenza degli strumenti di dashboard (ad esempio Power BI, Tableau) è un plus

Cosa ti offre questo ruolo:

- Esposizione all'impatto reale del business attraverso il processo decisionale basato sui dati

- Opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente globale e dinamico

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

Preferred Skills

-
Basic understanding of guest satisfaction metrics and NPS

-
Basic understanding of employee engagement metrics

- Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools

- Interest in customer journey, guest experience, and service improvement

- Familiarity with survey data analysis and open‑comment analysis

What This Role Offers You:

- Hands-on experience in analytics, KPI development, and dashboarding

- Exposure to real business impact through data-driven decision-making

- Opportunity to work in a global, dynamic environment

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

- Compétences Excel avancées; la connaissance des outils de tableau de bord (p. ex. Power BI, Tableau) est un plus

- Intérêt pour le voyage client, l'expérience client et l'amélioration du service

- Connaissance de l'analyse des données d'enquête et de l'analyse des commentaires ouverts

Ce que ce rôle vous offre :

- Expérience pratique en analyse, développement KPI et tableau de bord

- Exposition à un impact commercial réel grâce à la prise de décisions fondées sur les données

- Possibilité de travailler dans un environnement mondial et dynamique

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams.

Your Impact

- Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems.

- Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences.

- Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration.

- Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives.

- Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms.

- Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence.

- Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines.

- Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies.

- Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership.

- Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms.

Your Journey so far

- Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must.

- Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry.

- Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous.

- Strong background in broadcasting, web, TV, theatrical production, or digital media operations with managerial responsibility.

- Knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems and digital platforms.

- Solid IT literacy with understanding of systems architecture and AV integration.

- Full understanding of LES systems within the maritime industry.

- Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and CAD software).

- Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

- Proven ability to work autonomously, solve complex operational challenges, and manage global teams.

- International mindset with experience supporting mixed-nationality audiences and global operations.

- Willingness to travel extensively.

Your Essentials

- SWISS Resident or Visa Holder

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Guidare e definire la pianificazione strategica, l'implementazione e la gestione operativa del Dipartimento multimediale, supportando i sistemi audiovisivi (AV) in tutta la flotta e le infrastrutture aziendali. Superare i contenuti multimediali della flotta, l'innovazione tecnologica e le operazioni AV per massimizzare l'esperienza degli ospiti e mantenere standard di marca coerenti. Lavorare a stretto contatto con team globali, nuovi progetti di costruzione e stakeholder esterni, guidare la collaborazione tra intrattenimento, marketing, IT, digitale, produzione e funzioni tecniche per offrire esperienze digitali senza soluzione di continuità. L'ambito AV si espande oltre i tradizionali multimediali, supportando iniziative tecniche più ampie in tutta la divisione Entertainment, tra cui attività teatrali e ospiti, e fungendo da ponte chiave tra le esigenze di intrattenimento operativo e i team di consegna tecnica.

Il tuo impatto

- Gestione delle operazioni multimediali e AV, tra cui la progettazione, l'implementazione, l'ottimizzazione e la gestione del ciclo di vita di sistemi audio, video, broadcast, digital signage e content delivery.

- Partner con team tecnici a bordo e a bordo per garantire l'affidabilità delle attrezzature, la pianificazione della manutenzione strutturata, la pianificazione operativa e le strategie di riparazione concordate in tutta la flotta.

- Condurre iniziative interfunzionali con Intrattenimento, Marketing, IT, Digitale, Produzione e stakeholder tecnici per offrire esperienze innovative a bordo e a riva.

- Agire come principale collegamento tra intrattenimento, fornitori di produzione, appaltatori esterni, e il reparto Show and Multimedia, traducendo i requisiti creativi e operativi in soluzioni tecniche scalabili.

- Advitare e sostenere i progetti New Build sui requisiti tecnici multimediali e AV, garantendo un'integrazione tecnologica sostenibile e sicura.

- Collaborare con Brand, Marketing e fornitori di contenuti per sviluppare, aggiornare e implementare nuove strategie di contenuti multimediali basati sulle navi e iniziative di marketing a bordo.

- Definire e gestire i flussi di lavoro operativi e i piani di consegna per contenuti di intrattenimento e di marketing a bordo attraverso schermi di bordo e piattaforme digitali.

- supervisionare le relazioni dei fornitori, le attività di approvvigionamento e i budget associati per mantenere l'efficienza dei costi garantendo al tempo stesso l'eccellenza tecnica.

- Monitorare e valutare le tendenze tecnologiche globali per mantenere i sistemi della flotta innovativi, competitivi e allineati alle aspettative degli ospiti in evoluzione.

- Sviluppare, mantenere e migliorare continuamente le procedure operative standard e gli standard tecnici, garantendo coerenza, sicurezza e efficienza operativa in linea con le linee guida di Corporate Entertainment.

- Supervisione, valutazione e mentore nautica e touring tecnici a livello globale, garantendo il rispetto delle politiche di sicurezza, marittimo e societaria.

- Supporto di eventi live, trasmissioni, comunicazioni aziendali e iniziative multimediali attraverso la pianificazione strategica combinata con la leadership tecnica pratica.

- Gestione e gestione dei contenuti visivi forniti da partner interni ed esterni per la trasmissione su piattaforme a bordo.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- L'esperienza estesa all'interno degli ambienti di crociera è un must.

- Senior esperienza operativa e manageriale nell'industria dell'intrattenimento.

- Lingua madre inglese; italiano, tedesco o spagnolo vantaggioso.

- Forte sfondo nelle operazioni di trasmissione, web, TV, produzione teatrale o media digitali con responsabilità manageriale.

- Conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione dei contenuti aziendali e piattaforme digitali.

- Solida alfabetizzazione IT con la comprensione dell'architettura dei sistemi e dell'integrazione AV.

- La piena comprensione dei sistemi LES nell'industria marittima.

- alfabetizzazione avanzata del computer (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite e software CAD).

- Forte gestione del progetto e competenze di coordinamento degli stakeholder.

- Prove capacità di lavorare autonomamente, risolvere complesse sfide operative e gestire team globali.

- Mindset internazionale con esperienza che supporta il pubblico misto-nazionalità e le operazioni globali.

- Volontà di viaggiare molto.

I tuoi essenziali

- SWISS Resident o Visa Holder

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Der AV-Bereich erweitert sich über traditionelle Multimedia-Initiativen und unterstützt breitere technische Initiativen im gesamten Bereich Entertainment – einschließlich Theater- und Gastaktivitäten – und fungiert als Schlüsselbrücke zwischen operativen Unterhaltungsbedürfnissen und technischen Lieferteams.

Ihre Auswirkungen

- Verwalten Sie Multimedia- und AV-Betriebe, einschließlich Design, Implementierung, Optimierung und Lifecycle-Management von Audio-, Video-, Rundfunk-, Digital Signage- und Content-Liefersystemen.

- Partner mit Shore- und Onboard-Technical-Teams, um Gerätesicherheit, strukturierte Wartungsplanung, Betriebsplanung und vereinbarte Reparaturstrategien in der gesamten Flotte zu gewährleisten.

- Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Initiativen mit Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Produktion und technischen Stakeholdern, um innovative Gasterlebnisse an Bord und Ufer zu bieten.

- Aktivieren Sie als primäre Verbindung zwischen Unterhaltung, Produktionsanbietern, externen Vertragspartnern und der Abteilung Show und Multimedia, indem Sie kreative und operative Anforderungen in skalierbare technische Lösungen übersetzen.

- Neue Build-Projekte zu multimedialen und AV-technischen Anforderungen beraten und unterstützen, um eine zukunftssichere, nachhaltige Technologieintegration zu gewährleisten.

- Zusammenarbeit mit Brand-, Marketing- und Content-Providern, um neue schiffsbasierte Medieninhaltsstrategien und Marketing-Initiativen zu entwickeln, kurz und umzusetzen.

- Definieren und Projekt verwalten operative Workflows und Lieferpläne für Entertainment und Onboard-Marketing-Inhalte über Schiffsbildschirme und digitale Plattformen.

- Beaufsichtigen Sie die Beziehungen zwischen Anbietern, Beschaffungsaktivitäten und damit verbundenen Budgets, um die Kosteneffizienz bei gleichzeitiger technischer Exzellenz zu gewährleisten.

- Überwachen und bewerten Sie globale Technologietrends, um die Flottensysteme innovativ, wettbewerbsfähig zu halten und sich an die sich entwickelnden Gästeerwartungen anzupassen.

- Entwicklung, Aufrechterhaltung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Standard-Betriebsverfahren und technischen Standards, Sicherstellung der flottenweiten Konsistenz, Sicherheit und operativen Effizienz im Einklang mit den Unternehmensrichtlinien Entertainment.

- Schiffs- und Tourentechniker weltweit überwachen, bewerten und Mentor betreuen und sicherstellen, dass die Sicherheits-, See- und Unternehmenspolitik eingehalten wird.

- Unterstützung von Live-Events, Rundfunk-, Unternehmenskommunikations- und Multimedia-Initiativen durch strategische Planung in Verbindung mit technischer Führung.

- Verwalten und Regieren von visuellen Inhalten, die von internen und externen Partnern für die Übertragung auf Bord von Plattformen bereitgestellt werden.

Ihre Reise so weit

- Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Kreuzfahrt-Umgebungen ist ein Muss.

- Senior operative und Managererfahrung in der Entertainment-Branche.

- Muttersprache Englisch; Italienisch, Deutsch oder Spanisch vorteilhaft.

- Starker Hintergrund im Rundfunk, im Internet, im Fernsehen, in der Theaterproduktion oder im digitalen Medienbetrieb mit leitender Verantwortung.

- Kenntnisse von Content Management Systems und digitalen Plattformen.

- Solide IT-Literatur mit Verständnis von Systemarchitektur und AV-Integration.

- Vollständiges Verständnis von LES-Systemen in der maritimen Industrie.

- Erweiterte Computerkompetenz (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite und CAD-Software).

- Starkes Projektmanagement und Stakeholder-Koordinationsfähigkeiten.

- Bewiesene Fähigkeit, autonom zu arbeiten, komplexe operative Herausforderungen zu lösen und globale Teams zu verwalten.

- Internationale Denkweise mit Erfahrung, die das Publikum mit gemischter Nationalität und globalen Operationen unterstützt.

- Bereitschaft, ausführlich zu reisen.

Ihre Essenzen

- SWISS Resident oder Visa Holder

Unser Engagement

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

Superviser le contenu multimédia de la flotte, l'innovation technologique et les opérations AV afin de maximiser l'expérience des clients et de maintenir des normes de marque cohérentes. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes mondiales, les nouveaux projets de construction et les intervenants externes, favoriser la collaboration dans les domaines du divertissement, du marketing, de l'informatique, du numérique, de la production et des fonctions techniques pour offrir des expériences numériques sans faille. Le champ d'application de l'AV s'étend au-delà du multimédia traditionnel, soutenant des initiatives techniques plus larges dans l'ensemble de la division du divertissement, y compris les activités théâtrales et les activités d'invités, et servant de passerelle entre les besoins opérationnels en matière de divertissement et les équipes de prestation technique.

Votre impact

- Gérer les opérations multimédias et AV, y compris la conception, la mise en œuvre, l'optimisation et la gestion du cycle de vie des systèmes audio, vidéo, de radiodiffusion, d'affichage numérique et de diffusion de contenu.

- S'associer avec des équipes techniques à terre et à bord pour assurer la fiabilité de l'équipement, la planification de l'entretien structuré, l'horaire opérationnel et des stratégies de réparation convenues dans l'ensemble de la flotte.

- Appuyer les événements en direct, la radiodiffusion, les communications d'entreprise et les initiatives multimédias grâce à une planification stratégique combinée à un leadership technique pratique.

- Gérer et régir le contenu visuel fourni par les partenaires internes et externes pour la diffusion à travers les plateformes embarquées.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Une vaste expérience dans les environnements de croisière est un must.

- Expérience opérationnelle et de gestion au sein de l'industrie du divertissement.

- Langue maternelle Anglais; italien, allemand ou espagnol avantageux.

- Forts antécédents en matière de radiodiffusion, de web, de télévision, de production théâtrale ou de médias numériques avec responsabilité de gestion.

- Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de contenu d'entreprise et des plateformes numériques.

- Connaissance de l'informatique solide avec compréhension de l'architecture des systèmes et intégration AV.

- Compréhension complète des systèmes ERP dans l'industrie maritime.

- Connaissance avancée de l'informatique (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite et logiciel CAO).

- Capacité éprouvée de travailler de manière autonome, de résoudre des défis opérationnels complexes et de gérer des équipes mondiales.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

The Junior Architect Port Development Intern must be enrolled in a study program requiring a valid internship agreement. Candidates must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Junior Architect supporta il team Port Development attraverso una produzione veloce e accurata di disegni concettuali e tecnici. Il ruolo è focalizzato sull'esecuzione interna: trasformare gli input di progettazione in documentazione concettuale e visualizzazioni efficaci per supportare il processo decisionale in destinazioni private, terminal crociere, infrastrutture portuali e strutture correlate. Il tuo impatto - Sostenere la traduzione di input di business e design in studi di zoning, diagrammi spaziali di base e layout architettonici. - Assistere nello sviluppo di layout preliminari a seguito di indicazioni di progettazione interna e requisiti operativi. - Preparare pacchetti di progettazione concettuale di fase iniziale per la revisione interna e il coordinamento. - Produrre ponti di presentazione, diagrammi, narrazioni visive e schede materiali per supportare la comunicazione interna. - Sviluppare modelli 3D obbligatori e visualizzazioni in tempo reale per supportare recensioni interne e presentazioni a livello executive. - Aggiornare rapidamente, correggere e rivedere i disegni architettonici, inclusi piani, sezioni, elevazioni, layout, studi di facciata e diagrammi di circolazione. - Adapt e coordinare la porta e disegni civili, tra cui layout del sito, interfacce infrastrutturali, strade di circolazione e coordinamento del paesaggio duro. Il tuo viaggio finora - Forte passione per l'architettura e il mondo degli interni, dei materiali e della composizione spaziale. - Curioso e orientato al design, con attenzione alla proporzione, atmosfera e dettaglio. - Esecuzione guidata e altamente operativa. - Veloce nella produzione di disegno e revisioni. - Dettaglio e strutturato. - Confortevole lavoro sotto tempi stringenti in un ambiente di sviluppo dinamico. I tuoi essenziali - Proficienza avanzata in AutoCAD con forte velocità di redazione e precisione. - Forte capacità di modellazione 3D in SketchUp o Revit (preferito SketchUp). - Esperienza obbligatoria con strumenti di rendering in tempo reale (Enscape, Twinmotion o equivalente). - Buona conoscenza di Photoshop per post-produzione e correzioni. - Conoscenza di base di strumenti AI (o di interesse) come Diffusione Stabile o AI Magnifico. - La capacità di produrre in modo indipendente le visualizzazioni chiare e standard per il processo decisionale interno. - Portfolio che include disegni tecnici e visualizzazioni rese da condividere con il CV. Il Junior Architect Port Development Intern deve essere iscritto in un programma di studio che richiede un valido accordo di stage. I candidati devono avere un passaporto UE o avere il diritto legale di lavorare in Svizzera. È richiesta una completa competenza professionale in inglese; le lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.An exciting opportunity exists for a talented Digital Professional to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys. This role is based in the office in Geneva.The Digital Platforms Manager will lead the strategy, development and deployment of our travel App.

Your Impact

The Digital platforms Manager will:

- Lead the strategy of the EJ guest Area including My Explora and our travel App

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling.

- Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution.

- Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals.

- Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations.

- Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets.

- Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams

- Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives.

- Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment.

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field.

- 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building.

- Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred.

- Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets.

- Experience managing agencies and external creative partners.

Your Essentials

- Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable).

- Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

I tuoi essenziali - Esposizione al marketing del prodotto e ai prodotti basati sull'esperienza fisica (ship, hotel, resort o ambienti premium complessi altamente desiderabili). - Forte sensibilità creativa combinata con rigore operativo, attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder. - Comodo spostamento tra pensiero strategico del marchio e esecuzione dettagliata. - Fluente in inglese; lingue europee aggiuntive sono un forte vantaggio. Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence - Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams - Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives. - Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment. Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field. - 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building. - Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred. - Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets. - Experience managing agencies and external creative partners. Your Essentials - Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable). - Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills. - Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution. - Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage. At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.
descriptionByLocale.de: Wo Leidenschaft auf Gelegenheit trifft: Entdecken Sie Ihre Reise ins Außergewöhnliche. Your Purpose Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf entstand. Mit der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (vier davon derzeit in Planung) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und gestaltet, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis transformieren und neu definieren wird und eine eigene Kategorie schafft, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht. Als Teil des globalen Marketingteams und direkt an den Brand Director berichtet, spielt diese Rolle eine zentrale Rolle bei der Sicherung, Gestaltung und Aktivierung der Marke Explora Journeys über alle Kontaktpunkte hinweg, mit besonderem Fokus auf Markenkampagnen, Flotte und neue Markenentwicklungen. Mit Sitz in unserem Hauptsitz in Genf liegt diese Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Markenstrategie, Produktstorytelling und Umsetzung und arbeitet eng mit den Teams Produkt, Design, Hotelbetrieb, Commercial, PR, Medien und Digital zusammen, um die Marke mit Klarheit, Konsistenz und emotionaler Tiefe in allen Märkten zum Leben zu erwecken. Your Impact Brand Management & Governance – Fungieren Sie als zentraler Hüter der Marke Explora Journeys und unterstützen den Markenleiter im täglichen Management, in der Entwicklung und Entwicklung der Marke. - Sicherstellung der konsistenten Anwendung von Markenidentität, Tonfall, Botschaft und visueller Sprache über alle Kontaktpunkte, Kanäle und Gästereisen. - Leite die Entwicklung, Weiterentwicklung und Pflege von Markenrichtlinien, Frameworks und Master-Toolkits, um weltweit Relevanz, Klarheit und Skalierbarkeit sicherzustellen. - Überwachung der Markenumsetzung in verschiedenen Märkten und Partnern, proaktive Erkennung von Inkonsistenzen und Zusammenarbeit mit den Stakeholdern zur Sicherung von Luxus- und Gastgewerbestandards zu gewährleisten. - Beitrag zu Markenstrategie-Initiativen, Markenentwicklungsprojekten und interner Markenbildung, um das Markenverständnis und die Ausrichtung in der Organisation zu stärken. Kampagnen, Inhalte & Markenaktivierung – Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Master-Marken- und Produktkampagnen im Einklang mit Markenstrategie und kommerziellen Prioritäten. - Überwachung der Erstellung von Hero-Marken- und Produktressourcen, einschließlich Schlüsselvisuals, Copy-Frameworks, Broschüren, Fotografie und Videografie. - Eng mit den Medien-, Digital- und PR-Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, um einen kohärenten und hochwertigen Markenausdruck über bezahlte, besessene und verdiente Kanäle zu gewährleisten. - Verwaltung und Kuratierung von Marken-, Produkt- und Flotteninhalten innerhalb von DAM- und PIM-Systemen, um Genauigkeit, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und weltweite Marktadoption sicherzustellen. Produktmarketing – Flotten- und Borderlebnis – Besitzen und artikulieren Sie die Marken- und Produkterzählung der Explora Journeys-Flotte, indem Sie Schiffsdesign, Borderlebnisse und Servicephilosophie in überzeugende, klare und gastorientierte Storytelling übersetzen. - Als wichtiger Markenpartner der Produkt-, Neubau- und Hotelbetriebsteams zu fungieren und Projekte während des gesamten Schiffslebenszyklus zu unterstützen; von der frühen Konzeption über die Lieferung, den Start und die Weiterentwicklung im Betrieb. - Definition und Aktivierung von Ship-Level-Vorschlägen und -konzepten, Onboard-Erlebnissen, Suite-Konzepten, kulinarischen, Wellness- und Einzelhandelssäulen sowie Servicerituale. - Sicherstellung einer Übereinstimmung zwischen dem Bordgasterlebnis und dem dem Markt kommunizierten Markenversprechen. Launch & Go to Market Koordination – Unterstützung der Marken- und Produktbereitschaft für neue Markeninitiativen, Kampagnen, Schiffsstarts, wichtige Meilensteine und Onboarding-Innovationen. - Entwicklung von Master-Launch-Toolkits, um Kanäle, Märkte, Vertrieb und PR mit klaren Erzählungen, Positionierung und Vermögenswerten auszustatten. - Sicherstellung von Konsistenz, Klarheit und Markenausrichtung in allen internen und externen Kommunikationen im Zusammenhang mit Marken-, Flotten- und Produktentwicklung. Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit & operative Exzellenz – Fungieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Markenpartner über verschiedene Funktionen hinweg und fördern Sie die Abstimmung zwischen Marken-, Produkt-, kommerziellen und operativen Teams – Koordinieren Sie Budgets, Lieferanten, Prognosen, Bestellungen und Rechnungsstellungen im Zusammenhang mit Markeninitiativen. - Strategisches Markendenken mit praktischer Umsetzung in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld in Einklang bringen. Deine bisherige Reise – Masterabschluss in Marketing, Markenmanagement, Produktmarketing oder einem verwandten Bereich. - 8+ Jahre Erfahrung im Markenmanagement und Kampagnenaufbau. - Vorherige Erfahrung in Luxus-, Premium- oder High-End-Reise-, Gastgewerbe- oder Konsummarken wird stark bevorzugt. - Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in einem globalen Hauptsitz-Umfeld, Management von Markenrahmenwerken und Master-Assets in allen Märkten. - Erfahrung im Management von Agenturen und externen kreativen Partnern. Your Essentials – Einblick in Produktmarketing und physische, erlebnisorientierte Produkte (Schiffe, Hotels, Resorts oder komplexe, hochwertige Umgebungen sind sehr begehrt). - Starke kreative Sensibilität kombiniert mit operativer Strenge, Detailgenauigkeit und Stakeholder-Managementfähigkeiten. - Komfortabel zwischen strategischem Markendenken und detaillierter Umsetzung zu wechseln. - Fließend Englisch; zusätzliche europäische Sprachen sind ein großer Vorteil. Bei Explora Journeys definieren wir luxuriöse Ozeanreisen neu – wo Entdeckung, Wohlbefinden und tiefer Respekt vor dem Meer harmonisch zusammenkommen. Wir suchen leidenschaftliche Fachleute, die unsere Vision teilen, eine immersivere und transformative Entdeckung der inspirierendsten Ziele der Welt auf dem Schiff zu ermöglichen. Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Schließen Sie sich uns bei Explora Journeys an, wo ein Meer an Möglichkeiten auf Sie wartet. Deine Reise zum Ozean-Geisteszustand beginnt hier.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Là où la passion rencontre l’opportunité Découvrez votre parcours vers l’extraordinaire. Votre but Explora Journeys est une marque européenne de luxe dynamique, cosmopolite, imaginée au cœur de l’hôtellerie suisse à Genève. S’appuyant sur l’expertise maritime de plusieurs centaines d’années de notre société mère MSC Group, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (dont quatre sont actuellement en préparation) est construite et conçue d’une manière totalement différente et unique, transformant et redéfinissant l’expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie à part entière, séduisant la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe. Faisant partie de l’équipe marketing mondiale et relevant directement du Directeur de la Marque, ce rôle joue un rôle central dans la sauvegarde, la conception et l’activation de la marque Explora Journeys à tous les points de contact, avec un accent particulier sur les campagnes de marque, la flotte et les nouveaux développements de marque. Basé à notre siège à Genève, ce poste se situe à l’intersection de la stratégie de marque, du storytelling produit et de l’exécution, travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Design, Opérations Hôtelières, Commercial, RP, Médias et Digital pour donner vie à la marque avec clarté, cohérence et profondeur émotionnelle, sur tous les marchés. Votre gestion et gouvernance de la marque d’impact - Agir en tant que gardien central de la marque Explora Journeys, en soutenant le directeur de marque dans la gestion quotidienne, le développement et l’évolution de la marque. - Garantir une application cohérente de l’identité de marque, du ton de voix, du message et du langage visuel à travers tous les points de contact, canaux et parcours des invités. - Diriger le développement, l’évolution et la maintenance des lignes directrices de marque, des cadres et des ensembles d’outils maîtres, garantissant la pertinence, la clarté et la scalabilité à l’échelle mondiale. - Surveiller l’exécution de la marque sur les marchés et partenaires, en identifiant de manière proactive les incohérences et en collaborant avec les parties prenantes pour protéger les normes de luxe et d’hôtellerie. - Contribuer aux initiatives de stratégie de marque, aux projets d’évolution de marque et à l’éducation interne à la marque, renforçant la compréhension et l’alignement de la marque au sein de l’organisation. Campagnes, contenu et activation de marque - Dirigez le développement et la mise en œuvre des campagnes principales de marque et de produits, conformément à la stratégie de marque et aux priorités commerciales. - Superviser la création des actifs de marque et de produits phares, incluant les visuels clés, les cadres de texte, les brochures, la photographie et la vidéographie. - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Médias, Digital et RP pour garantir une expression de marque cohérente et premium sur les canaux payants, détenus et acquis. - Gérer et sélectionner le contenu de la marque, des produits et des flottes au sein des systèmes DAM et PIM, garantissant la précision, la facilité d’utilisation et l’adoption sur le marché mondial. Marketing produit – Flotte & expérience à bord – Posséder et articuler la marque et le récit produit de la flotte Explora Journeys, en traduisant la conception du navire, les expériences à bord et la philosophie de service en une narration captivante, claire et centrée sur les invités. - Agir en tant que partenaire clé de marque pour les équipes Produit, Construction Neuve et Opérations Hôtelières, soutenant des projets tout au long du cycle de vie du navire ; depuis le concept initial jusqu’à la livraison, le lancement et l’évolution en service. - Définir et activer les propositions et concepts au niveau du navire, les expériences à bord, les concepts de suites, les piliers culinaires, bien-être et de commerce, ainsi que les rituels de service. - Assurer l’alignement entre l’expérience client à bord et la promesse de marque communiquée au marché. Coordination du lancement et du lancement - Soutenir la préparation de la marque et du produit pour de nouvelles initiatives, campagnes, lancements de navires, étapes majeures et innovations intégrées. - Développer des kits d’outils de lancement maîtres pour doter les canaux, marchés, ventes et relations publiques de récits clairs, de positionnement et d’actifs. - Garantir la cohérence, la clarté et l’alignement de la marque dans toutes les communications internes et externes liées à l’évolution de la marque, de la flotte et du produit. Collaboration interfonctionnelle et excellence opérationnelle - agir en tant que partenaire de marque de confiance à travers les fonctions, favorisant l’alignement entre les équipes de marque, produit, commercial et opérationnel - Coordonner budgets, fournisseurs, prévisions, ordres d’achat et facturation liés aux initiatives de marque. - Équilibrer la réflexion stratégique de la marque avec l’exécution concrète dans un environnement rapide. Votre parcours jusqu’à présent - Master en marketing, gestion de marque, marketing produit ou domaine connexe. - 8+ ans d’expérience en gestion de marque et construction de campagnes. - Expérience préalable dans le luxe, le voyage haut de gamme ou haut de gamme, l’hôtellerie ou les marques grand public fortement privilégiées. - Expérience avérée dans un environnement de siège mondial, gérant des cadres de marque et des actifs maîtres sur les marchés. - Expérience en gestion d’agences et de partenaires créatifs externes. Vos essentiels - Exposition au marketing produit et aux produits basés sur l’expérience physique (navires, hôtels, complexes hôteliers ou environnements complexes haut de gamme très recherchés). - Une forte sensibilité créative combinée à une rigueur opérationnelle, une attention aux détails et des compétences en gestion des parties prenantes. - Être à l’aise entre la réflexion stratégique de la marque et l’exécution détaillée. - Maîtrise de l’anglais ; des langues européennes supplémentaires constituent un avantage important. Chez Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage océanique de luxe — où la découverte, le bien-être et un profond respect des mers se rejoignent en harmonie. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d’une manière plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par mer. Êtes-vous prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d’extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous chez Explora Journeys, où un océan d’opportunités vous attend. Votre voyage vers l’État d’Esprit de l’Océan commence ici.
