descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihr Ziel

Der F&B Service Manager ist eine strategische Hauptsitz-basierte Rolle, die für die Bereitstellung von Führung, Aufsicht und Beratung für alle Food & Beverage Service-Operationen in der gesamten Flotte verantwortlich ist. Diese Rolle sorgt für Service-Exzellenz, Konsistenz im Gasterlebnis und Ausrichtung auf Unternehmensstandards. Als primäre Verbindung zwischen Schifffahrtsteams und Unternehmensführung treibt der Manager von F&B Service Qualität, Innovation, Compliance und Talententwicklung in allen F&B-Operationen an. Diese Rolle berichtet direkt an den Vizepräsidenten der F&B.

Ihre Auswirkungen

Strategische Operationen & Standards

- F&B-Service-Standards und bewährte Praktiken definieren, umsetzen und pflegen.

- Entwicklung und Überwachung strategischer Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Gasterfahrung und betrieblicher Effizienz in allen Schiffen.

- Koordination mit Shipboard-Teams, um die Einhaltung von Unternehmensrichtlinien, Verfahren und Markenstandards zu gewährleisten.

- Durchführung von Fernaudits, operativen Bewertungen und Bewertungen, um Service-Exzellenz zu erhalten.

Gasterlebnis und Qualitätssicherung

- Überwachen Sie die Gästezufriedenheit und die F&B-Leistungsmetriken, analysieren Sie Trends und empfehlen Verbesserungen.

- Zusammenarbeit mit kulinarischen und Getränke-Teams, um das an Bord der F&B-Angebote zu innovieren und zu erhöhen.

- Stellen Sie durch unternehmensgeführte Programme die Ausrichtung auf globale Gesundheits-, Sicherheits- und Hygieneprotokolle sicher.

Ausbildung und Führung

- Entwerfen und überwachen Sie Trainingsprogramme für F&B-Teams, um die Übereinstimmung mit der Dienstleistungsphilosophie der Marke zu gewährleisten.

- Mentor und entwickeln die F&B-Führungskräfte der Schifffahrt, um den beruflichen Fortschritt und die Nachfolgeplanung zu unterstützen.

Personal- und Führungsaufsicht

- Zusammenarbeit mit HR über Leistungsbewertungen, Promotionen, Rotationen und Karrierewege für F&B-Personal.

- Förderung einer leistungsfähigen Kultur, die in Anerkennung, Entwicklung und Fairness verwurzelt ist.

Fleet Support & Headquarters Koordination

- Führen Sie als wichtigste Unternehmensverbindung für alle F&B-Dienste in der gesamten Flotte.

- Koordinierte F&B-Ausrüstungsplanung, Materialbeschaffung und Integration von Markenstandards.

- Kompilieren und analysieren Sie operative Berichte, Reisezusammenstände und Leistungsmetriken für die Unternehmensführung.

- Beteiligen Sie sich bei den wichtigsten Schifffahrtssitzungen fern oder persönlich nach Bedarf.

Finanzaufsicht

- Unterstützung der finanziellen Nachhaltigkeit und Rentabilität der F&B-Operationen in der gesamten Flotte.

- Durchführung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsprogramme zur Erreichung operativer und finanzieller Ziele.

- Kostenkontrolle, Inventarplanung und Ressourcenzuweisung in Abstimmung mit Shipboard-Teams.

Ihre Reise so weit

- Mindestens 15 Jahre im High-End-Food & Beverage-Betrieb.

- Mindestens 5 Jahre in leitenden Führungsrollen innerhalb der Gastfreundschaft oder Kreuzfahrten.

- Erfahrungen in der Multi-Site-Betriebsaufsicht.

Ihre Essenzen

Führung und Kommunikation

- Strategischer, dynamischer Führer mit Erfahrung, multikulturelle Teams zu verwalten.

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, fließend in Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen ein Vermögen.

Technisches und operatives Wissen

- Proficient in Microsoft Office und branchenspezifischen Systemen.

- Starkes Verständnis von HR-Protokollen, Arbeitsvorschriften und Compliance-Standards.

- Expertenwissen über F&B-Operationen, Getränkeprogrammierung und luxuriöse Gastfreundschaft Standards.

Berufliche Kompetenzen

- Strategischer Denker mit operativer Agilität und starkem Geschäft.

- Ergebnisgetrieben, detailorientiert und sehr kollaborativ.

- Ermöglicht die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zwischen Firmen- und Schiffsteams.

Unser Engagement

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre but

Le gestionnaire des services F&B est un responsable stratégique de l'administration centrale qui assure le leadership, la surveillance et l'orientation de toutes les activités des services d'alimentation et de boissons dans l'ensemble de la flotte. Ce rôle assure l'excellence du service, l'uniformité de l'expérience des invités et l'harmonisation avec les normes ministérielles. En tant que principale liaison entre les équipes de bord et le leadership de l'entreprise, le gestionnaire du Service F&B favorise la qualité, l'innovation, la conformité et le développement des talents dans toutes les opérations de F&B. Ce rôle relève directement du vice-président de F&B.

Votre impact

Opérations stratégiques et normes

- Définir, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des normes de service et des pratiques exemplaires à l'échelle de la flotte.

- Élaborer et superviser des initiatives stratégiques pour améliorer l'expérience des invités et l'efficacité opérationnelle de tous les navires.

- Coordonner avec les équipes de bord pour assurer le respect des politiques, des procédures et des normes de marque.

- Effectuer des vérifications à distance, des examens opérationnels et des évaluations pour maintenir l'excellence du service.

Expérience des invités et assurance qualité

- Surveiller la satisfaction des clients et les mesures du rendement des F et B, analyser les tendances et recommander des améliorations.

- Collaborer avec des équipes culinaires et de boissons pour innover et élever l'offre de F&B à bord.

- Assurer l'harmonisation avec les protocoles mondiaux de santé, de sécurité et d'hygiène au moyen de programmes dirigés par l'entreprise.

Formation et perfectionnement en leadership

- Concevoir et superviser des programmes de formation pour les équipes F&B afin d'assurer la cohérence avec la philosophie de service de la marque.

- Mentor et former des chefs de F&B à bord des navires pour appuyer l'avancement professionnel et la planification de la relève.

Surveillance des ressources humaines et du leadership

- Collaborer avec les RH aux examens du rendement, aux promotions, aux rotations et à l'orientation de carrière du personnel des F&B.

- Promouvoir une culture de haute performance ancrée dans la reconnaissance, le développement et l'équité.

Soutien de la flotte et coordination du quartier général

- Servir de principale liaison ministérielle pour toutes les questions relatives aux services F&B dans l'ensemble de la flotte.

- Coordonner la planification de l'équipement F&B, l'approvisionnement en matériel et l'intégration des normes de marque.

- Compiler et analyser les rapports opérationnels, les résumés de voyage et les indicateurs de rendement pour le leadership ministériel.

- Participer à des réunions clés à distance ou en personne au besoin.

Contrôle financier

- Soutenir la viabilité financière et la rentabilité des activités de F&B dans l'ensemble de la flotte.

- Mettre en oeuvre des programmes d'amélioration continue pour atteindre les objectifs opérationnels et financiers.

- Surveiller le contrôle des coûts, la planification des stocks et l'affectation des ressources en coordination avec les équipes de bord.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Au moins 15 ans dans les exploitations haut de gamme d'aliments et de boissons.

- Au moins 5 ans à des postes de direction dans l'hôtellerie de luxe ou les opérations de croisière.

- Expérience éprouvée en matière de surveillance opérationnelle sur plusieurs sites.

Vos essentiels

Leadership et communication

- Leader stratégique et dynamique avec expérience en gestion d'équipes multiculturelles.

- Excellentes compétences en communication, maîtrise de l'anglais; langues supplémentaires un atout.

Connaissances techniques et opérationnelles

- Compétence en Microsoft Office et systèmes spécifiques à l'industrie.

- Une bonne compréhension des protocoles RH, des règlements du travail et des normes de conformité.

- Connaissances spécialisées des opérations de F&B, de la programmation des boissons et des normes d'accueil de luxe.

Compétence professionnelle

- Un penseur stratégique avec une agilité opérationnelle et un sens des affaires.

- Des résultats axés sur les détails et une collaboration étroite.

- Capable de travailler de manière interfonctionnelle entre les équipes d'entreprise et de bord.

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Shore Excursions Fleet Supervisor oversees all aspects of Shore Excursions on board MSC Fleet and Is responsible and accountable for driving sales through the effective coaching of the Shore Excursions teams in areas such as profit growth, expense control, product training, staff development and customer service. The goal is to ensure compliance with corporate standards, enhance operational excellence, maximize revenue performance, and improve customer satisfaction scores.

Your Impact

- Monitor and supervise the performance of the assigned ships to achieve Company's assigned targets.

- Support the onboard team to achieve maximum revenue and Guests' Satisfaction

- Ensure application/implementation of company standard and procedures

- Coach and train onboard teams ensuring active team participation

- Audit safety procedures in place with our Tour Operators

Your Journey so far

- At least 4 years of experience in the role of onboard Shorex Manager

- Fluent in English (minimum B2) and any additional language is a plus

- Computer proficiency with the MS Office Package

- Knowledge of onboard booking systems is an advantage

- Analytical skills

- Experience in training and people development

- Strong Interpersonal and Communication skills

- This is a crew contract involving a long period of travel on board our ships and our offices

The Fleet Supervisor’s activities are supervised and coordinated by the Corporate Team, to whom they report all actions, ideas, and implementations, while also providing relevant analyses to monitor and enhance the results required by the Company.

Hold a valid passport

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Infrastructure Investments (Caribbean)

titleByLocale.it: Senior Project Manager - Investimenti nelle Infrastrutture (Caraibi)
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal de projet - Investissements en infrastructure (Caraïbes)

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il tuo scopo

Stiamo cercando un PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager dedicato ad alto livello per supervisionare un progetto di investimento infrastrutturale strategico nei Caraibi, mentre istituisce la disciplina di governance e esecuzione attraverso progetti attuali e futuri nella pipeline di investimento.
Questo ruolo ha piena responsabilità per la consegna del progetto, la finanza, la costruzione, commerciale, operativo, le risorse umane, le normative e le dimensioni degli stakeholder. Il candidato di successo agirà come unico punto di coordinamento e controllo tra investitori, appaltatori, operatori, prestatori e parti interessate del governo.

Il tuo impatto

• Stabilire e guidare un sistema di gestione dei progetti, tra cui governance, reporting, controlli e KPI.
• Guidare l'esecuzione end-to-end di grandi progetti infrastrutturali, dallo sviluppo attraverso la costruzione e le operazioni.
• supervisiona la consegna delle costruzioni e i finanziamenti del progetto, inclusi budget, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, requisiti di credito e reporting.
• Lead commerciale e contratti di gestione, fornitore e concessione accordi PPP.
• Assicurare la disponibilità operativa e la consegna, compresi i sistemi, il personale e le procedure.
• Coordinare la pianificazione delle risorse umane e della forza lavoro, garantire il rispetto delle leggi sul lavoro locali e la gestione efficace degli appaltatori.
• Identificare e gestire i rischi di progetto attraverso dimensioni tecniche, finanziarie, regolamentari, ESG e politiche.
• Fornire supporto di supervisione e esecuzione PMO per ulteriori progetti nell'imbuto di sviluppo.

Il tuo viaggio finora

• Corso di laurea in Ingegneria, Finanza, Business, o campo correlato; Laurea preferito.
• 15 anni di esperienza in infrastrutture su larga scala o progetti di asset reali.
• Dimostrata leadership di progetti complessi e ad alta intensità di capitale con più stakeholder.
• Forte esperienza nella costruzione, nella finanza di progetto, nei contratti commerciali e nelle operazioni.
• Esperienza nei mercati emergenti e/o nella regione caraibica fortemente preferita.
• PMP / PRINCE2 o certificazione equivalente preferito.

I tuoi essenziali

• Hands-on, strutturato e altamente responsabile
• Presenza e credibilità esecutivo con gli stakeholder senior
• Confortevole lavoro in ambienti complessi e multi-giurisdizionali
• Volontà di viaggiare ed essere in loco come richiesto

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihr Ziel

Wir suchen einen hochkarätigen, engagierten PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager, um ein strategisches Infrastruktur-Investitionsprojekt in der Karibik zu überwachen und gleichzeitig Governance- und Ausführungsdisziplin für aktuelle und zukünftige Projekte in der Investitionspipeline zu etablieren.
Diese Rolle trägt die volle Rechenschaftspflicht für Projektlieferungen, Finanzierungen, Bauwesen, Gewerbe, Betrieb, HR, Regulierung und Stakeholder Dimensionen. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird als einziger Punkt der Koordinierung und Kontrolle zwischen Investoren, Vertragspartnern, Betreibern, Kreditgebern und Regierungsvertretern fungieren.

Ihre Auswirkungen

• Aufbau und Leitung eines Projektmanagementsystems, einschließlich Governance, Berichterstattung, Kontrollen und Kennzahlen.
• Die End-to-End-Ausführung von großen Infrastrukturprojekten, von der Entwicklung über den Bau und in den Betrieben.
• Beaufsichtigt die Baulieferung und Projektfinanzen, einschließlich Budgets, Cashflow, CAPEX/OPEX-Tracking, Kreditanforderungen und Berichterstattung.
• Führen Sie Handels- und Vertragsmanagement, Lieferant und Konzession PPP-Vereinbarungen.
• Gewährleistung der operativen Bereitschaft und Übergabe, einschließlich Systeme, Personal und Verfahren.
• Koordination der Personal- und Personalplanung, Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der lokalen Arbeitsgesetze und effektives Vertragsmanagement.
• Ermittlung und Verwaltung von Projektrisiken in technischen, finanziellen, regulatorischen, ESG und politischen Dimensionen.
• Unterstützung von PMO-Übersicht und Ausführung für weitere Projekte im Entwicklungstrichter.

Ihre Reise so weit

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Engineering, Finanzen, Business oder verwandten Bereich; Master-Abschluss bevorzugt.
• 15 Jahre Erfahrung in groß angelegten Infrastrukturen oder realen Asset-Projekten.
• Demonstrierte Führung komplexer, kapitalintensiver Projekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern.
• Starke Erfahrung im Bereich Bau, Projektfinanzierung, Handelsverträge und Betriebsabläufe.
• Die Erfahrung in Schwellenländern und/oder in der karibischen Region ist stark bevorzugt.
• PMP / PRINCE2 oder gleichwertige Zertifizierung bevorzugt.

Ihre Essenzen

• Hand-on, strukturiert und hochrechenbar
• Exekutive Präsenz und Glaubwürdigkeit mit Senioren
• Komfortables Arbeiten in komplexen, multi-jurisdiktiven Umgebungen
• Reisebereitschaft und nach Bedarf vor Ort

Unser Engagement

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre but

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chef de projet / directeur principal de projet de haut calibre et de haut niveau pour superviser un projet d'investissement stratégique dans l'infrastructure dans les Caraïbes, tout en établissant une discipline de gouvernance et d'exécution pour les projets actuels et futurs dans le domaine des investissements.
Ce rôle comporte la pleine responsabilité de l'exécution des projets, en ce qui concerne les finances, la construction, le commerce, l'exploitation, les RH, la réglementation et les intervenants. Le candidat retenu agira comme point unique de coordination et de contrôle entre les investisseurs, les entrepreneurs, les exploitants, les prêteurs et les intervenants gouvernementaux.

Votre impact

• Établir et diriger un système de gestion de projet, y compris la gouvernance, l'établissement de rapports, les contrôles et les ICR.
• Conduire l'exécution de bout en bout des grands projets d'infrastructure, du développement à la construction et à l'exploitation.
• Supervise l'exécution des travaux de construction et les finances des projets, y compris les budgets, les flux de trésorerie, le suivi CAPEX/OPEX, les exigences des prêteurs et les rapports.
• Diriger la gestion commerciale et contractuelle, le fournisseur et les accords de PPP de concession.
• Assurer la préparation opérationnelle et le transfert, y compris les systèmes, les effectifs et les procédures.
• Coordonner la planification des ressources humaines et de la main-d'œuvre, en veillant au respect des lois locales du travail et à une gestion efficace des entrepreneurs.
• Recenser et gérer les risques liés aux projets sur les plans technique, financier, réglementaire, ESG et politique.
• Fournir un appui à la supervision et à l'exécution de projets supplémentaires dans l'entonnoir de développement.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

• Baccalauréat en ingénierie, finance, affaires ou domaine connexe; Masters préféré.
• 15 ans d'expérience dans des projets d'infrastructure ou de biens immobiliers de grande envergure.
• Leadership démontré de projets complexes et à forte intensité de capital avec de multiples parties prenantes.
• Forte expérience dans les domaines de la construction, du financement de projets, des contrats commerciaux et des opérations.
• L'expérience des marchés émergents et/ou de la région des Caraïbes est fortement préférée.
• PMP / PRINCE2 ou certification équivalente préférée.

Vos essentiels

• Pratique, structurée et hautement responsable
• Présence de l'exécutif et crédibilité auprès des principaux acteurs
• Travail confortable dans des environnements complexes et multijuridictionnels
• Volonté de voyager et d'être sur place au besoin

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

titleByLocale.it: Vice Presidente Global SPA e Wellness
titleByLocale.en: Vice President Global SPA and Wellness
titleByLocale.fr: Vice-président Global SPA et Wellness

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Vice President Global SPA and Wellness is the global business owner for all onboard SPA, wellness, beauty, and fitness operations across the Cruise Division of MSC Group, spanning MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) and Explora Journeys (Luxury).

The role has full accountability for SPA and treatment programs, fitness and thermal areas, salon services, wellness retail, medical aesthetics (where applicable), and future digital wellness offerings.

This position ensures that luxury wellness standards, service rituals, therapeutic excellence, and holistic wellbeing philosophies are fully embedded—particularly for Explora Journeys—while maintaining scalable, brand-differentiated wellness frameworks across the fleet.

The VP defines the long-term global SPA and wellness vision, drives commercial performance, elevates guest satisfaction, and evolves wellness concepts that differentiate MSC Group’s Cruise Division across contemporary, premium, and luxury segments.

Your Impact

Strategic & Commercial Leadership

- Define and lead the global SPA and wellness strategy across contemporary, premium, and luxury brands, aligned with differentiated guest profiles and brand positioning.

- Act as business owner for Global SPA and Wellness, with explicit accountability for luxury wellness concepts and standards.

- Own the end-to-end commercial roadmap, including treatment architecture, pricing strategy, promotions, capacity optimisation, and end-to-end guest journey design.

- Lead strategic negotiations with SPA operators, wellness partners, medical aesthetics providers (where permitted), product brands, and equipment suppliers.

- Drive growth in high-margin and premium wellness categories, including signature treatments, medical aesthetics, fitness and longevity programs, wellness retail, and personalised wellbeing journeys.

- Develop scalable yet brand-distinct SPA and wellness frameworks, enabling selective deployment of premium and luxury concepts across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

Operational and Brand Excellence

- Oversee SPA operations fleet-wide, ensuring consistent service delivery, treatment quality, hygiene standards, and guest satisfaction.

- Define service standards, therapist certification requirements, training programs, and performance benchmarks across all SPA formats.

- Ensure luxury wellness excellence for Explora Journeys, including service rituals, therapist conduct, holistic programming, privacy standards, and immersive wellness environments.

- Introduce tier-specific wellness concepts, signature and luxury rituals, experiential programming, and destination-inspired treatments.

- Ensure fleet readiness for newbuilds and dry docks, including SPA layout design, equipment selection, CAPEX planning, and concept activation.

Financial Management

- Own the full P&L for SPA and Wellness across all Cruise Division brands, including annual budgets, revenue targets, margin improvement, and cost control.

- Optimise therapist productivity, treatment mix, pricing discipline, retail attachment rates, staffing models, and concession economics.

- Leverage advanced analytics to drive demand forecasting, yield management, guest segmentation, booking optimisation, and treatment performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance, and Newbuild teams to integrate wellness into the overall guest experience.

- Collaborate with CRM and Digital teams on pre-cruise wellness engagement, onboard booking optimisation, and personalised wellness journeys.

- Align SPA offerings with itinerary, destination, and onboard programming to maximise relevance differentiation, and revenue.

Leadership & Organisational Development

- Lead a global HQ and fleet SPA and wellness organisation, including strategy, operations, training, and partner management teams.

- Build a culture of guest-centric service excellence, luxury wellness stewardship, commercial discipline, and continuous innovation.

- Mentor senior leaders and strengthen capabilities across SPA operations, luxury wellness concept development, and data-driven performance management.

Your Journey so far

- 15+ years senior leadership experience in SPA, wellness, hospitality, cruise, or multi-site service businesses.

- Proven success owning complex P&Ls and driving profitability in service-led environments.

- Deep expertise in SPA operations, wellness programming, service quality management, and luxury guest experience standards.

- Strong experience managing third-party operators, concession models, or global vendor partnerships.

Your Essentials

- Excellent leadership, negotiation, and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

- Willingness to travel extensively and operate in a fast-paced international environment.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Il Vice President Global SPA and Wellness è il proprietario di business globale per tutte le operazioni a bordo di SPA, benessere, bellezza e fitness attraverso la Divisione Crociera di MSC Group, che comprende MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) e Explora Journeys (Luxury). Il ruolo ha piena responsabilità per i programmi SPA e di trattamento, aree fitness e termali, servizi di salone, vendita al dettaglio benessere, estetica medica (dove applicabile), e future offerte di benessere digitale. Questa posizione garantisce che gli standard di lusso per il benessere, i rituali di servizio, l'eccellenza terapeutica e le filosofie olistiche per il benessere siano completamente incorporati, in particolare per Explora Journeys, pur mantenendo ambienti benessere scalabili e differenziati dal marchio in tutta la flotta. Il VP definisce la visione globale di SPA e benessere a lungo termine, spinge le prestazioni commerciali, eleva la soddisfazione degli ospiti, ed evolve concetti di benessere che differenziano la Divisione Crociera di MSC Group attraverso segmenti contemporanei, premium e di lusso. Il tuo Impact Strategic & Commercial Leadership - Definire e guidare la strategia globale di SPA e benessere attraverso marchi contemporanei, premium e di lusso, allineati con profili ospiti differenziati e posizionamento del marchio. - No. Atto come proprietario di business per Global SPA e Wellness, con responsabilità esplicita per i concetti e gli standard di lusso. - Proprio la roadmap commerciale end-to-end, tra cui l'architettura del trattamento, la strategia dei prezzi, le promozioni, l'ottimizzazione della capacità e la progettazione del viaggio degli ospiti end-to-end. - Condurre trattative strategiche con gli operatori SPA, partner benessere, fornitori di estetica medica (dove consentito), marchi di prodotto e fornitori di attrezzature. - Crescita dell'azionamento in categorie di benessere ad alto livello e premium, tra cui trattamenti firma, estetica medica, programmi di fitness e longevità, vendita al dettaglio di benessere e viaggi di benessere personalizzati. - Sviluppare framework SPA e wellness scalabili ma distinguibili, consentendo la distribuzione selettiva di concetti premium e di lusso attraverso MSC Cruises e Explora Journeys. Eccellenza operativa e di marca - supervisionare le operazioni SPA in tutto il mondo, garantire la fornitura coerente di servizi, qualità del trattamento, standard igienici e soddisfazione degli ospiti. - Definire standard di servizio, requisiti di certificazione terapeutica, programmi di formazione e benchmark di prestazioni in tutti i formati SPA. - Assicurare l'eccellenza del benessere di lusso per i viaggi Explora, inclusi rituali di servizio, condotta terapeutica, programmazione olistica, norme sulla privacy e ambienti benessere immersivi. - Introdurre concetti di benessere specifici, rituali di firma e lusso, programmazione esperienziale e trattamenti ispirati alla destinazione. - Assicurare la disponibilità della flotta per nuove costruzioni e banchine a secco, tra cui progettazione di layout SPA, selezione di attrezzature, pianificazione CAPEX e attivazione del concetto. Financial Management - Possedere la P&L completa per SPA e Benessere in tutti i marchi della Divisione Crociera, inclusi budget annuali, obiettivi di ricavi, miglioramento dei margini e controllo dei costi. - Ottimizzare la produttività del terapeuta, il mix di trattamento, la disciplina dei prezzi, i tassi di attaccamento al dettaglio, i modelli di personale e l'economia di concessione. - Leva analisi avanzate per guidare la previsione della domanda, la gestione dei rendimenti, la segmentazione degli ospiti, l'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni e le prestazioni del trattamento. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner a stretto contatto con i team Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance e Newbuild per integrare il benessere nell'esperienza complessiva degli ospiti. - Collabora con i team CRM e Digital nell'impegno pre-cruise wellness, nell'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni a bordo e nei viaggi di benessere personalizzati. - Allineare le offerte SPA con itinerario, destinazione e programmazione a bordo per massimizzare la differenziazione di rilevanza e le entrate. Leadership & Sviluppo Organizzativo - Leader di un'organizzazione globale HQ e SPA e benessere della flotta, tra cui team di strategia, operazioni, formazione e gestione dei partner. - Costruisci una cultura dell'eccellenza del servizio guest-centric, della gestione del benessere di lusso, della disciplina commerciale e dell'innovazione continua. - Mentor senior leader e rafforzare le capacità tra le operazioni SPA, lo sviluppo del concetto di benessere di lusso e la gestione delle prestazioni guidata dai dati. Il vostro viaggio finora - 15+ anni esperienza di leadership senior in SPA, benessere, ospitalità, crociera, o multi-sito servizi business. - Proven successo proprietario di P&L complessi e la redditività di guida in ambienti orientati al servizio. - Profonda competenza nelle operazioni SPA, programmazione del benessere, gestione della qualità dei servizi e standard di esperienza degli ospiti di lusso. - Forte esperienza nella gestione di operatori di terze parti, modelli di concessione, o partnership di fornitori globali. I tuoi Essentials - Eccellente leadership, negoziazione e competenze di gestione delle parti interessate interfunzionali. - Volontà di viaggiare e operare in un ambiente internazionale veloce. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Operational and Brand Excellence - Übersee SPA-Betriebe flottenweit, um eine konsequente Service-Lieferung, Behandlungsqualität, Hygienestandards und Gästezufriedenheit zu gewährleisten. - Definieren Sie Service-Standards, Therapeuten-Zertifizierungsanforderungen, Schulungsprogramme und Leistungs-Benchmarks in allen SPA-Formaten. - Vergewissern Sie sich Luxus-Wellness-Exzellenz für Explora Journeys, einschließlich Service Rituale, Therapeutenverhalten, ganzheitliche Programmierung, Datenschutzstandards und immersive Wellness-Umgebungen. - Einführung tierspezifischer Wellness-Konzepte, Signaturen und Luxusrituale, experimentelle Programmierung und zielorientierte Behandlungen. - Gewährleistung der Flottenbereitschaft für Neubauten und Trockendocks, einschließlich SPA Layout-Design, Geräteauswahl, CAPEX-Planung und Konzeptaktivierung. Finanzmanagement - Besitzen Sie die volle P&L für SPA und Wellness auf allen Cruise Division Marken, einschließlich Jahresbudgets, Umsatzziele, Margenverbesserung und Kostenkontrolle. - Optimieren Sie die Produktivität der Therapeuten, den Behandlungsmix, die Preisdisziplin, die Anpassungsraten des Einzelhandels, die Personalmodelle und die Konzessionsökonomie. - Leverage fortschrittliche Analysen, um die Nachfragevorausschätzung, Ertragsmanagement, Gastsegmentierung, Buchungsoptimierung und Behandlungsleistung zu steigern. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner eng mit Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance und Newbuild-Teams zusammen, um Wellness in das Gesamt-Gasterlebnis zu integrieren. - Zusammenarbeit mit CRM- und Digital-Teams im Bereich der Vor-Kreuz-Wellness-Vermittlung, bei der Buchungsoptimierung und personalisierten Wellness-Reises. - Align SPA bietet mit Reiseroute, Ziel und Onboard-Programmierung, um relevante Differenzierung und Einnahmen zu maximieren. Leadership & Organisational Development - Führen Sie eine globale HQ und Flotte SPA und Wellness-Organisation, einschließlich Strategie, Operationen, Schulungen und Partner-Management-Teams. - Bauen Sie eine Kultur der gastorientierten Service-Exzellenz, Luxus-Wellness Stewardship, Handelsdisziplin und kontinuierliche Innovation. - Mentor leitende Führungskräfte und stärken die Fähigkeiten über SPA-Betriebe, die Entwicklung des Luxus-Wellness-Konzepts und das datengesteuerte Leistungsmanagement. Ihre Reise bisher - 15 Jahre Führungserfahrung in SPA, Wellness, Gastfreundschaft, Kreuzfahrt oder Multi-Site-Service-Unternehmen. - Bewährte Erfolgsbesitzung komplexer P&Ls und treibende Rentabilität in betriebsgeführten Umgebungen. - Tiefes Know-how in SPA-Betrieben, Wellness-Programmierung, Service-Qualitätsmanagement und Luxus-Gästeerlebnis-Standards. - Starke Erfahrung bei der Verwaltung von Drittanbietern, Konzessionsmodellen oder globalen Anbieterpartnerschaften. Ihre Essentials - Ausgezeichnete Führung, Verhandlung und funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder Management Fähigkeiten. - Willingness zu reisen und in einem rasanten internationalen Umfeld zu betreiben. Unser Engagement Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft zu schaffen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und ermächtigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Bewerben Sie sich heute, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre objectif Le vice-président Global SPA and Wellness est le propriétaire d'entreprise mondial pour toutes les opérations de SPA, de bien-être, de beauté et de fitness à bord de la division Croisières du Groupe MSC, couvrant MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) et Explora Journeys (Luxury). Ce rôle est entièrement responsable des programmes de SPA et de traitement, des zones de conditionnement physique et thermique, des services de salon, de la vente au détail de bien-être, de l'esthétique médicale (le cas échéant) et des futures offres de bien-être numérique. Cette position garantit que les normes de bien-être de luxe, les rituels de service, l'excellence thérapeutique et les philosophies holistiques du bien-être sont entièrement intégrés, en particulier pour Explora Journeys, tout en maintenant des cadres de bien-être évolutifs et différenciés en fonction de la marque dans l'ensemble de la flotte. Le VP définit la vision globale à long terme du SPA et du bien-être, stimule la performance commerciale, élève la satisfaction des clients et développe des concepts de bien-être qui différencient la division Croisière MSC Group de tous les segments contemporains, haut de gamme et de luxe. Votre impact Leadership stratégique et commercial - Définissez et dirigez la stratégie globale de SPA et de bien-être dans les marques contemporaines, premium et de luxe, alignée sur des profils d'invités différenciés et le positionnement de la marque. - Oui. Agir en tant que propriétaire d'entreprise pour Global SPA et Wellness, avec une responsabilité explicite pour les concepts et les normes de bien-être de luxe. - Posséder la feuille de route commerciale de bout en bout, y compris l'architecture de traitement, la stratégie de tarification, les promotions, l'optimisation des capacités et la conception de voyage de bout en bout. - Mener des négociations stratégiques avec les opérateurs de SPA, les partenaires de bien-être, les fournisseurs d'esthétique médicale (si possible), les marques de produits et les fournisseurs d'équipement. - Favoriser la croissance dans les catégories de bien-être haut de gamme et haut de gamme, y compris les traitements phares, l'esthétique médicale, les programmes de conditionnement physique et de longévité, la vente au détail de bien-être et des voyages de bien-être personnalisés. - Développer des cadres de SPA et de bien-être évolutifs et distinctifs, permettant le déploiement sélectif de concepts haut de gamme et de luxe à travers MSC Cruises et Explora Journeys. Excellence en matière d'exploitation et d'image de marque - Surveiller les opérations de SPA à l'échelle de la flotte, en assurant une prestation de services uniforme, la qualité du traitement, les normes d'hygiène et la satisfaction des clients. - Définir les normes de service, les exigences de certification des thérapeutes, les programmes de formation et les repères de rendement pour tous les formats de SPA. - Assurer l'excellence en bien-être de luxe pour Explora Journeys, y compris les rituels de service, la conduite des thérapeutes, la programmation holistique, les normes de confidentialité et les environnements de bien-être immersifs. - Introduire des concepts de bien-être spécifiques, des rituels de signature et de luxe, une programmation expérientielle et des traitements inspirés de la destination. - Veiller à ce que la flotte soit prête pour les nouvelles constructions et les cales sèches, y compris la conception de la configuration du SPA, la sélection de l'équipement, la planification du CAPEX et l'activation du concept. Gestion financière - Posséder l'intégralité des P&L pour SPA et Wellness dans toutes les marques de la division Croisière, y compris les budgets annuels, les objectifs de revenus, l'amélioration de la marge et le contrôle des coûts. - Optimiser la productivité des thérapeutes, la combinaison de traitements, la discipline des prix, les taux d'attachement au détail, les modèles de dotation et l'économie des concessions. - Tirer parti d'analyses avancées pour la prévision de la demande, la gestion des rendements, la segmentation des clients, l'optimisation des réservations et les performances de traitement. Collaboration interfonctionnelle - S'associer étroitement aux équipes des opérations hôtelières, de la médecine, de la condition physique, du commerce de détail, de F&B, de Shorex, du numérique, des finances et de Newbuild pour intégrer le bien-être à l'expérience globale des clients. - Collaborer avec les équipes CRM et Digital sur l'engagement de bien-être pré-cruise, l'optimisation des réservations à bord et des voyages de bien-être personnalisés. - Aligner les offres de SPA avec l'itinéraire, la destination et la programmation à bord pour maximiser la différenciation de pertinence et les revenus. Leadership & Organisational Development - Dirigez une organisation globale d'AC et de flotte de SPA et de bien-être, incluant des équipes de stratégie, d'exploitation, de formation et de gestion de partenaires. - Bâtir une culture d'excellence en matière de services axés sur les clients, d'intendance du bien-être de luxe, de discipline commerciale et d'innovation continue. - Mentor dirigeants et renforcer les capacités dans les opérations SPA, le développement de concepts de bien-être de luxe et la gestion de la performance axée sur les données. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - 15 ans et plus d'expérience en leadership senior en SPA, bien-être, hospitalité, croisière ou multi-site entreprises de services. - Succès prouvé posséder des P&L complexes et stimuler la rentabilité dans les environnements dirigés par les services. - Une expertise approfondie dans les opérations SPA, la programmation de bien-être, la gestion de la qualité du service et les normes d'expérience des clients de luxe. - Forte expérience en gestion d'opérateurs tiers, de modèles de concession ou de partenariats mondiaux avec des fournisseurs. Vos essentiels - Excellent leadership, négociation et compétences de gestion interfonctionnelles des intervenants. - Volonté de voyager largement et d'opérer dans un environnement international rapide. Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités vous attendent. Postulez aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

titleByLocale.it: Experience Development & Delivery Manager - Nuove Costruzioni
titleByLocale.en: Experience Development & Delivery Manager - New Builds

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?
We are seeking a New Builds Development & Delivery Manager who will act as an extension of the Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, enhancing strategic thinking, improving decision‑making speed, and helping bring robust, high-quality concepts to senior leadership.
This role is not operational and not a presentation-updating position. It is a partnership role, designed for someone who can think critically, structure ambiguous problems, challenge insights, and support the development of transformational guest experience concepts.You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, and Strategy, ensuring concepts are analytically sound, insight-driven, and aligned with the company expectations. You’ll gain exposure to strategic discussions, influence senior decision-making, and drive clarity across innovation workstreams.
If you are a sharp thinker, a natural challenger, and a trusted partner able to elevate the work of others, this is the role for you

Your Impact

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

- Support leadership in preparing for SVP/EVP/Executive Committee discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy, and Operations teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

- Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.

- Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.

- Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

Your Essentials

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo eccelle nel trasformare la complessità in chiarezza? Sei eccitato plasmando idee, presupposti stimolanti e amplificando l’impatto di un leader?
• Stiamo cercando un New Builds Development & Delivery Manager che agirà come estensione del Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, migliorando il pensiero strategico, migliorando la velocità decisionale e aiutando a portare concetti robusti e di alta qualità alla leadership senior. Questo ruolo non è operativo e non è una posizione di presentazione. Si tratta di un ruolo di partnership, progettato per qualcuno che può pensare criticamente, strutturare problemi ambigui, sfidare intuizioni e sostenere lo sviluppo di concetti di esperienza degli ospiti trasformazionali. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con le parti interessate attraverso Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild e Strategy, assicurando che i concetti siano analiticamente sani, orientati agli insight e allineati alle aspettative dell'azienda. Potrai ottenere l'esposizione a discussioni strategiche, influenzare il processo decisionale senior, e guidare la chiarezza attraverso i flussi di lavoro di innovazione. Se sei un pensatore acuto, un sfidante naturale, e un partner affidabile in grado di elevare il lavoro degli altri, questo è il ruolo per voi Il tuo impatto Supporto strategico e partenariato di pensiero - Agire come partner strategico diretto al Senior Manager, aiutando il pensiero della struttura, i problemi della struttura e affinare le narrazioni dei concetti. - Partecipare o condurre riunioni selezionate per conto dell'Innovazione dell'esperienza ospite - Preparare brevi strategici, quadri decisionali e documenti di sintesi per conversazioni a livello SVP. Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Comunicazione - Materiali di storytelling chiari, concisi e strategicamente sani per forum di leadership - Trasformare informazioni complesse in narrazioni ad alto impatto. - Sostenere la leadership nella preparazione delle discussioni del Comitato SVP/EVP/Executive. Collaborazione trasversale - Coinvolgere con i team Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy e Operations per raccogliere idee e concetti di forma. - Condurre lo sviluppo e la consegna di nuovi concetti di intrattenimento, esperienze e spazi attraverso la nostra flotta. - Agire come il collegamento chiave tra partner creativi, operazioni e funzioni aziendali, garantendo allineamento e buy-in in ogni fase. Project & Stakeholder Management - Guidare la chiarezza nei flussi di lavoro strutturando le linee temporali, identificare i punti di decisione e anticipare i rischi. - Seguire con gli stakeholder per garantire il progresso e l'allineamento. - Elevare i problemi presto e proporre scenari di mitigazione. Il tuo viaggio finora - 5-8 anni di strategia, innovazione, business design, consulenza o gestione strategica del progetto. - L'esperienza in ospitalità, crociera, vendita al dettaglio, beni di consumo, o l'esperienza degli ospiti è un vantaggio forte. - Forte sfondo nella progettazione e nell'esecuzione di esperienze orientate agli ospiti, dal concetto alla consegna. - Un equilibrio di creatività e know-how operativo, in grado di sognare grande e consegnare praticamente. - Provato track record nella gestione di team complessi e interfunzionali (operazioni, creativo, marketing, vendite, ricavi, comunicazioni), con la capacità di unire prospettive diverse intorno a una singola visione. - Ottima conoscenza dei moderni strumenti di comunicazione visiva (Canva, Adobe Suite, piattaforme creative basate su AI) per produrre documenti visivi e attività di storytelling oltre i tradizionali ponti di scorrimento. - Eccellente capacità di costruzione di relazioni; in grado di ispirare, influenzare e connettersi tra diverse squadre. - Forte capacità di narrazione e presentazione, con fiducia a livello esecutivo. - Capacità di viaggiare 20-30% del tempo. - Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive a plus. I tuoi essenziali - Proficienza in Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook. - EU Passport o diritto di lavoro in Svizzera. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Werden Sie durch die Gestaltung von Ideen, anspruchsvollen Annahmen und die Verstärkung der Auswirkungen eines Führers angeregt? Wir suchen einen New Builds Development & Delivery Manager, der als Erweiterung des Senior Managers of Concept Innovation fungiert, strategisches Denken verbessert, die Entscheidungsgeschwindigkeit verbessert und dazu beiträgt, robuste, qualitativ hochwertige Konzepte an Senior Leader zu bringen. Diese Rolle ist nicht funktionsfähig und nicht eine Präsentations-updating Position. Es ist eine Partnerschaftsrolle, die für jemanden entwickelt wird, der kritisch denken kann, mehrdeutige Probleme strukturieren, Erkenntnisse herausfordern und die Entwicklung von transformierenden Gasterlebnis-Konzepten unterstützen kann. Sie werden sich mit strategischen Diskussionen auseinandersetzen, ältere Entscheidungsfindungen beeinflussen und Klarheit über Innovationsarbeitsbereiche schaffen. Wenn Sie ein scharfer Denker, ein natürlicher Herausforderer und ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner sind, der die Arbeit anderer erhöhen kann, ist dies die Rolle für Sie Ihre Auswirkungen Strategische Unterstützung und Gedankenpartnerschaft - Aktivieren Sie als direkter strategischer Partner für den Senior Manager, helfen Sie Strukturdenken, Rahmenprobleme und schärfen Konzept-Erzählungen. - Erwarten Sie ausgewählte Treffen im Auftrag von Guest Experience Innovation - Bereiten Sie strategische Briefe, Entscheidungsrahmen und Synthesedokumente für SVP-Level-Konversationen vor. Narrative Gebäude & Executive-Ready Kommunikation - Handwerk klare, prägnant und strategisch fundierte Geschichten für Führungsforen - Transformieren Sie komplexe Informationen in hochwirksame Erzählungen. - Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung auf SVP/EVP/Executive Committee Diskussionen. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Lead Onboard Casino team tecnici, garantendo operazioni fluide, mantenendo elevati standard di servizio e massimizzando la generazione di ricavi. Come Casino Slot e Technical Operations Manager, sarai responsabile del monitoraggio delle prestazioni delle slot machine, analisi dei dati di gioco e delle strategie di attuazione per migliorare la soddisfazione e la redditività del giocatore. Il vostro ruolo coinvolgerà ispezioni regolari e pianificazione di manutenzione per garantire che tutte le slot machine funzionino correttamente ed efficacemente. Sarete anche responsabili della gestione dell'inventario, dell'ordine di nuove attrezzature, del coordinamento delle installazioni e degli aggiornamenti. Si prevede di rimanere aggiornati sulle tendenze del settore e sulle tecnologie emergenti, adattando attivamente le operazioni per mantenere la conformità e il vantaggio competitivo.

Il tuo impatto

• supervisionare tutti i progetti tecnici e partecipare attivamente alla loro attuazione. Mantenere un'eccellente linea di comunicazione con la riva e il reparto tecnico nave per garantire che tutti i progetti del casinò siano dispiegati in base al programma e conformi agli standard tecnici e di sicurezza dell'azienda.
• Assistere con analisi di bilancio, previsione e ricavi.
• Gestire budget, costi di controllo e ottimizzare l'allocazione delle risorse.
• Supporto e guida a bordo del team di gestione del casinò su ogni nave attraverso una comunicazione costante e visite operative regolari delle navi. Discutere le aree di preoccupazione specifiche per l'Operazione e il prodotto specifico del marchio, e allo stesso modo affrontare i punti di encomio.
• Fornire una valutazione accurata e obiettiva delle operazioni e del personale del casinò a bordo.
• Analisi delle entrate, identificazione delle tendenze con la capacità di creare soluzioni strutturate per aumentare o migliorare i flussi di reddito. Esplora nuovi modi per aumentare i ricavi esistenti e /o migliorare le pratiche di lavoro attuali, mantenendo allo stesso tempo un elevato standard tecnico e di sicurezza a bordo delle nostre navi.
• Isolare le aree sotto lo standard con i membri del team di gestione del Casino Shipboard.
• Formazione di tutti i team di gestione in Slot Revenue, Sicurezza e Sorveglianza.
• Confermare che le misure di sicurezza soddisfano i requisiti minimi.
• Fornire assistenza e consulenza per la risoluzione dei problemi tramite e-mail ai team tecnici di bordo.
• Valutare, valutare e rivedere i dati per l'organizzazione di progetti e/o fornire indicazioni su attività, attività o processi secondo le linee guida aziendali.

Il tuo viaggio finora

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle operazioni di slot da casinò.
• L'esperienza precedente che lavora su una nave da crociera è obbligatoria.

I tuoi essenziali

• Forte conoscenza delle normative di gioco e dei requisiti di conformità.
• Eccellente leadership, comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.
• Proficienza nell'analisi dei dati di gioco e dei rapporti finanziari.
• Capacità di gestire budget, costi di controllo e ottimizzare le risorse.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy across all MSC Cruises markets, with a focus on driving direct sales through digital advertising levers, setting and achieving KPIs, and developing innovative digital campaigns across multiple channels. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in performance marketing and digital sales development at a positive ROAS, along with strong expertise in digital advertising campaign strategy, paid media planning and implementation, and team leadership. Additionally, the role will involve developing affiliation and partnership programs as part of an integrated digital engagement strategy to broaden reach, drive qualified traffic, and support long-term customer value.

Your Impact

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with MSC stakeholders across various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and opportunities—while balancing the global objectives set by headquarters.

• Set and achieve KPIs for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.

• Lead internal meetings, QBRs, and annual reviews by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analytics, market trends, and the competitive landscape.

• Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio, and Video channels—tailored to business goals and market dynamics.

• Collaborate with internal teams—including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product, and agency partners—to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality assets aligned with annual digital sales targets.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to enhance revenue streams through existing and new digital strategies, while improving campaign ROAS and experimenting with innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.

• Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring effective customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place across all paid media touchpoints.

• Maintain oversight of account resourcing and profitability to ensure HQ and local markets are managed efficiently and profitably.

• Serve as the main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.

• Continuously review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.

• Collaborate with country and HQ stakeholders to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with MSC Cruises’ B2C revenue goals.

• Lead and optimize affiliate and partnership programs to drive qualified traffic and conversions, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.

• Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Journey so far

titleByLocale.en: Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.de:

Sie werden unsere Test- und Einsichtsstrategie speerdeln, um Conversion-Raten, Buchungsvolumen und Umsatz pro Besucher zu maximieren, während Sie eine Best-in-Class-Experimentierungspraxis aufbauen, die einen nachhaltigen Wettbewerbsvorteil bietet. Diese Rolle wird einen starken strategischen Fokus auf den direkten Kanal haben, die Lead-Generation optimieren und Erkenntnisse nutzen, um einen höheren Kundenerwerb, Engagement und Lebenswert zu steigern.

Ihre Auswirkungen

• Konzipieren und führen Sie eine umfassende datengesteuerte Strategie über alle digitalen Touchpoints aus, wobei sich insbesondere das direkte Kanalwachstum und die Akquisitionskosten durch verbesserte Conversion-Raten konzentrieren.

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams einschließlich Produkt-, Design-, Engineering-, Marketing- und Webanalysen, um A/B-Tests zu konzeptualisieren und zu entwerfen, die die Auswirkungen von Website- und Kampagnenänderungen effektiv messen.

• Führen Sie strategische Initiativen innerhalb des direkten Kanals, um einen datengesteuerten Ansatz zur Lead-Generierung, Publikumssegmentierung und Customer Journey-Optimierung zu gewährleisten, um Conversion und Engagement zu verbessern.

• Entwickeln Sie tiefe Customer Journey-Einsichten durch fortschrittliche Analytik, identifizieren Sie wichtige Reibungspunkte und Möglichkeiten, um das Nutzererlebnis zu verbessern und höhere Buchungswerte zu fahren.

• Führen Sie fortschrittliche digitale Segmentierungsanalysen durch, um hochwertige Kundensegmente und Personalisierungsmöglichkeiten über den Conversion-Trichter aufzudecken.

• Erarbeiten Sie robuste Messrahmen, um die kommerziellen Auswirkungen von Optimierungsinitiativen zu quantifizieren, einschließlich Testdesign, Umsatzprognose und Nachimplementierungsanalyse.

• Entwickeln Sie umfassende Leistungs-Dashboards, die Testergebnisse, Kundenverhaltensmetriken und kommerzielle Kennzahlen kombinieren, um die Conversion-Rate-Optimierung zu führen.

• Innovation in Personalisierungs- und Optimierungsstrategien vorantreiben, um den direkten Channel-Beitrag mit den neu angenommenen Tools zu maximieren (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Realtime CDP).

• Entwicklung von Test-Frameworks, die schnelle Gewinne mit langfristigen strategischen Initiativen ausgleichen.

Ihre Reise so weit

• Abschluss in Geschäft, Marketing, Analytik oder einem verwandten Bereich, mit 5 Jahren relevanter Erfahrung.

• Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz von D2C-Dateneinsichten zur Gestaltung von Marketing- und Produktstrategien, insbesondere bei der Buchung von Trichteroptimierung.

• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit A/B-Testwerkzeugen wie Adobe Target.

Ihre Essenzen

• Expertise in Webanalyseplattformen wie Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics und AEP.

• Starke analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten in handlungsfähige Geschäftsstrategien zu destillieren.

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv über Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und Entscheidungsfindung zu beeinflussen.

• Fähigkeit, in einem schnelllebigen, sich entwickelnden Umfeld zu leben und mehrere Initiativen gleichzeitig zu verwalten.

• EU-Pass oder Arbeitsrecht in der Schweiz.

Unser Engagement

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
